name: What Brothers are For
source:
You play a young boy who is always willing to lend his younger sister a hand. Especially when she comes to you with a major problem. Something is wrong with her vagina. Being the best big brother ever, you help her out with her problem.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230605223108/https://lewdcorner.com/threads/what-brothers-are-for-1-0-short-vn.422/]Lewdcorner[/url]]

你将扮演一名向来乐于向妹妹伸出援手的少年——尤其是当她带着天大的烦恼找上门来的时候。她的私处似乎出了点状况。身为世上最称职的好哥哥，你自然要出手帮她排忧解难。
